test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Given below are six sentences. A and F are the first and the last sentences. The rest of the sentences namely B, C, D and E are jumbled. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. After about half an hour on the marsh, there was a sound of a shot nearby.

B. “Over there! Come on!” said the sergeant pointing to the sea.

C. We all stopped and listened carefully.

D. We all ran towards the sea.

E. Then we heard two more shots and a red rocket rose into the sky.

F. Soon we could see the light of torches, and hear shouting and splashing.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'ACEBDF.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **C **will follow **A**, as there was a **sound **so people over there **stopped and listened **carefully.
 
• **E **will follow **next**, as when they were **listening carefully **they **heard **two more shots.
 
• **D **will follow **B**, as the **people **over there **ran **towards the sea when the **sergeant told them **to do so.
 
• Thus *option 2 *is the correct answer.

The correct sequence is:

A
